description.text: Research fields: 1. Long-span Bridge Design Theory 2. Bridge Structural Dynamics, Stability and Spatial Non-linear Analysis 3. Bridge Construction Techniques and Project (intelligent) Control Techniques 4. Bridge Structural Damage, Disaster Analysis, Reinforcing and Health Test 5. Design Theory and Key Construction Techniques for Tunnels and Underground Works Major courses: Numerical Analysis, Matrix Analysis, Mathematical Statistics, Mathematical Equations, Elastic and Plastic Mechanics, Structural Finite Element Analysis, Bridge Design Theory, Modern Tunnel Engineering Techniques and Applications, etc.

duration.text: The Bridge and Tunnel Engineering at Chongqing Jiaotong University is a 3 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 4166 USD/per year ￥ 30000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Master's degree diploma Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Transcript of postgraduate school 5. HSK Certificate (No need for English-taught program) Level 3 or above 6. Health certificate(optional) Photocopy of physical examination record. 7. Two recommendation letters From professor,associate professor or equivalents. 8. Certification of no criminal record 9. Resume Written in Chinese or in English

requirements.text: Non-Chinese, under 45 years old, with a Master’s Degree before the coming September or having worked for 6 years after winning a Bachelor’s Degree, excellent in academic performance, passed HSK 4
